title: The Permanent

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The Permanent is a boutique Vancouver event venue. Book a tour today and find out how we can help you craft the perfect event experience for your guests. Located at 330 West Pender Street in the vibrant Crosstown district, The Permanent is one of Vancouver’s most beloved heritage venues. Our stunning historic space offers a timeless backdrop for weddings, corporate events, trade shows, conferences, private parties, and more. Conveniently situated in the heart of downtown, The Permanent combines architectural elegance with modern amenities-perfect for hosting unforgettable events of every scale.
